comparison_rules: Run both arms only after this protocol is committed.
Primary fixture, oracle, same bridge ports, fault schedule and acceptance assertions are immutable.
Baseline only changes released persistent_api module; currently supported imports remain identified by their byte hashes.
Correct baseline functional behavior remains passing: it already composes GroundedPlan when explicit ports are injected.
Record lifecycle result before emergency fixture cleanup; close all clients in finally in either arm.
Fail CLI on unregistered protocol/fixture/oracle drift, changed runtime source during run, disabled assertions, unexpected baseline result or failing current checks.
Write receipts exclusively to a new path; never overwrite existing evidence.
limitations: Fake choices do not establish model intelligence, prompt effectiveness or arbitrary-claim entailment.
Complete quoted-source and frozen-analysis checks cover the authored outputs only; no semantic judge or real model is run.
The inherited fixture is exposed answer-informed development data with a posthoc deterministic output oracle, not held-out test gold.
Retrieval is a fixed exact excerpt sequence; no real RAG relevance, coverage or semantic embedding quality is measured.
The explicit conflict control does not discover a real document contradiction.
Backend recreation is not interpreter restart or full browser/session recovery; existing TCP and UI pilots remain separate evidence.
Temporary simulated ledger bookkeeping does not reconcile team billing or lift C5 halt.
